```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load.packages}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(permute)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
packageVersion("vegan")
```

```{r read.in.data}
# Specifying colClass so leading 0 is not dropped
counts = read.csv("../data/rh_abx_genus_level_counts.csv",
                  colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))

counts$days_in_program <- NULL

# Specifying colClass so leading 0 is not dropped
metadata = read.csv("../data/abx_covariates_with_statins_a1c_all_covars.csv",
                    colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))
 
filtered_metadata = filter(metadata, public_client_id %in% counts$public_client_id)
```

Remember 0 col mean the taxon is not observed in anyone in our cohort subset;
remove these

```{r remove.zero.columns}
counts = counts %>% pivot_longer(-public_client_id) %>%  # ASVs the rows again
  group_by(public_client_id) %>%                         # Groups by person
  group_by(name) %>%                                     # Group by taxa
  mutate(total = sum(value)) %>%
  filter(total != 0) %>%                                 # Keep taxa that not 0
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = public_client_id) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

Now we want to look at the counts/reads per person to see the range

```{r check.counts.per.person}
# This will check the number of counts per sample
counts_per_person <- counts %>% pivot_longer(-public_client_id) %>% 
  group_by(public_client_id) %>%                # Groups by person
  summarise(total = sum(value)) %>%             # Sum counts/person
  arrange(total)                                # Shows lowest counts first

# Least num counts is 21869, max is 498642
```

Want to see number of features as a function of the counts

```{r generate.data.to.plot.relationship}
# Add clients as row names, drop that col
rownames(counts) <- counts$public_client_id
counts$public_client_id <- NULL

# Count the number of features per row
row_sums_non_zero <- rowSums(counts != 0)
# names(row_sums_non_zero) # This is ordered how I want

# Order the tibble (sum of counts)
ordered_tibble_asc <- counts_per_person %>%
  arrange(public_client_id)

data <- data.frame(x = ordered_tibble_asc$total, # Sum of counts
                   y = row_sums_non_zero)        # Num of obs features
```

```{r check.if.log.fit.good}
# Fit logarithmic curve using nls()
log_fit <- nls(y ~ a + b * log(x), data = data, start = list(a = 0, b = 1))

# Print the summary of the fit
summary(log_fit)
```

```{r}
# Generate predicted values for the curve
curve_data <- data.frame(x = seq(min(data$x), max(data$x), length.out = 100))
curve_data$y <- predict(log_fit, newdata = curve_data)
```


```{r}
# Plot the data and the fitted curve
ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey") +
  geom_line(data = curve_data, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Fitted Logarithmic Curve",
       x = "Sum of counts per person",
       y = "Number of obs features")
```

## Repeat the same thing with Vegan package and see what we get

```{r create.matrix}
# Need to have it in matrix form for vegan
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts)
```

```{r get.rarefied.richness}
# Here S should be the same thing we calc above YAY
S <- specnumber(counts_matrix)          # obs num of species = row_sums_non_zero
raremax <- min(rowSums(counts_matrix))  # Gets min counts, also same as above

# Get rarefied species count
Srare <- rarefy(counts_matrix, raremax) # Num obs spec when rarefying
plot(S, Srare, xlab = "Observed No. of Species", ylab = "Rarefied No. of Species")
abline(0, 1)
```
Below the vertical line is = to raremax, or the min counts we set

```{r}
rarecurve(counts_matrix, step = 200, sample = raremax, col = "blue", cex = 0.6)
```

## Get other diversity estimates

```{r generate.rarefied.matrix}
set.seed(3)
rarefied_counts <- rrarefy(counts_matrix, raremax)
```

```{r save.rarefied.csv}
# This will be used for logistic regression and the microbe-metab regressions
write.csv(rarefied_counts, "../data/rh_abx_cohort_rarefied_counts.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Shannon

```{r shannon}
H <- diversity(rarefied_counts)
```

### Berger-Parker

```{r berger_parker}
bp <- apply(rarefied_counts, 1, function(x) {
  if(sum(x)==0) return(NA)
  max(x) / sum(x)
})
```

## Put these together and export

```{r create_alpha_df}
obs_feats <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(Srare), observed_features = Srare)
shannon <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(H), shannon_index = H)
bp_df <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(bp), berger_parker = bp)

alpha_meta <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by="public_client_id", all=TRUE),
             list(filtered_metadata, obs_feats, shannon, bp_df))
alpha_meta
```

```{r save.csv}
write.csv(alpha_meta, "../data/rh_abx_covar_alpha_divs_rarefied.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Now let's do the same thing with the follow up stool count tables

```{r read.in.get.matrix}
counts_followup = read.csv("../data/repeat_client_follow_up_genera_counts.csv",
                  colClasses = c(public_client_id = "character"))

# Add clients as row names, drop that col
rownames(counts_followup) <- counts_followup$public_client_id
counts_followup$public_client_id <- NULL

counts_matrix_followup <- as.matrix(counts_followup)
```

```{r}
S_fu <- specnumber(counts_matrix_followup)          # obs num of species = row_sums_non_zero
raremax_fu <- min(rowSums(counts_matrix_followup))  # Gets min counts, also same as above

# Get rarefied species count
Srare_fu <- rarefy(counts_matrix_followup, raremax_fu) # Num obs spec when rarefying
plot(S_fu, Srare_fu, xlab = "Observed No. of Species", ylab = "Rarefied No. of Species")
abline(0, 1)
```

```{r}
rarecurve(counts_matrix_followup, step = 200, sample = raremax_fu, col = "blue", cex = 0.6)
```

```{r}
set.seed(3)
rarefied_counts_followup <- rrarefy(counts_matrix_followup, raremax_fu)
```


```{r}
# Get Shannon
H_fu <- diversity(rarefied_counts_followup)

# Get BP
bp_fu <- apply(rarefied_counts_followup, 1, function(x) {
  if(sum(x)==0) return(NA)
  max(x) / sum(x)
})

# Write together?
obs_feats_fu <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(Srare_fu), 
                           observed_features_followup = Srare_fu)
shannon_fu <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(H_fu), 
                         shannon_index_followup = H_fu)
bp_df_fu <- data.frame(public_client_id = names(bp_fu), 
                       berger_parker_followup = bp_fu)

alpha_meta_followup <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by="public_client_id", all=TRUE),
             list(obs_feats_fu, shannon_fu, bp_df_fu))
alpha_meta_followup
```

```{r save.csv.followup}
write.csv(alpha_meta_followup, "../data/abx_followups_alphadivs_rarefied.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
